address: Custom House Quay, 38b Arwenack Street, Falmouth, TR11 3JF, United Kingdom
bio: The open kitchen takes centre stage at this old quayside warehouse. Each dish on the set menu is named after the inspiration behind it, be it a local farmer or place, and foraged ingredients also play their part. Don’t be surprised to see the occasional South African influence too though, as the chef-owner is from Cape Town. The pared-back room has a natural feel, and it’s worth checking out the glass-walled wine cellar....
